text:
Priya: Quick question — PR 3782 is ready but CI failed on fmt check. Can someone take a quick look at the wrap/line-length changes I made?

Jon: I'll take a look now. Is it gofmt or our linter showing the errors?

Priya: Both — gofmt flagged some layout changes, and the linter called out a rename I made (ReqCtx -> ReqCtxShort). I shortened a few identifiers and manually wrapped some lines. Thought shorter names were ok for internal stuff.

Maya: small nit — our repo convention is 100 cols, avoid manual wrapping unless it's a long string. Run `gofmt -s` + `goimports -w`. Also, please don't change exported/API names without a compat shim.

Jon: +1 on Maya. Suggest reverting any exported rename to the original public name and keep an alias if you want a shorter local symbol. Quick patch idea:
```diff
- type ReqCtx struct { ... }
+ type RequestContext struct { ... }
+ type ReqCtx = RequestContext // keep short alias for internal use
```
Run `make format` and push, I'll re-check.

Priya: Ack — I'll revert the exported rename and run the formatting commands now.

Sam: For the proto/trailing-comma CI failure you mentioned earlier, run `./tools/proto_format.sh` then commit the generated JSON. If CI still complains it's probably the buf plugin; ping me and I can re-run the formatter step in CI.

CI Bot: Build 3782 — fmt check failed (gofmt). Details: https://ci.example/3782

Priya: Pushed a follow-up at 3304002000 that reverts the rename, runs `gofmt -s` and `goimports -w`, and updates the generated proto JSON. PTAL.

Maya: LGTM other than one import-order nit (stdlib before external). `goimports -w` should fix that automatically; after you push that I'll approve.

Jon: Approved :thumbsup: I'll merge in the 10:00 merge window if CI stays green.

Priya: Thanks all — appreciate the quick eyes :pray:
